resources.string: A quiet place to notice how you feel and take small, steady steps.
Mind-Ur-Set helps you log daily mood check-ins, write short reflections, try gentle thought reframes, and chat with a calm companion.
It does not diagnose conditions, replace a therapist, or offer medical care. If you ever need urgent help, crisis numbers stay one tap away.
Your check-ins, reflections, and baseline stay on this phone. Only companion messages leave your device when you choose to chat, and you can export or delete everything anytime.
Four quick choices so the app starts from where you are today. No typing needed.
1. How has your mood been lately?
2. How has your sleep been in the last week?
3. How supported do you feel right now?
4. What do you want help with most?
